report.summary: This round modified 3 files: exporters/export_board.py, tests/test_export_board.py and CLAUDE.md. local/tests/test_conformance.py is still modified from the earlier round but untouched in this one. Added 3 tests and tightened 1. Red first: the deep-nesting test failed with an uncaught RecursionError from carried(), and a probe showed the U+D800 escape raising UnicodeEncodeError from the unguarded encode. Suites, run from the worktree on the working tree: python -m unittest discover -s tests ran 274 (271 + 3 added), OK. node tests/page.test.mjs passed all 68 page checks, exit 0. python -m unittest discover -s local/tests ran 90, OK. Mutation check on a scratch copy, not the worktree: dropping .astimezone(timezone.utc) fails only the UTC test; writing carried tabs with indent=2 fails only the byte-format test; pinning each file's first carriedSince fails only the set-again test; unmutated, all 3 pass. One behaviour change beyond the findings: truncated, non-UTF-8 and non-object kept files were kept silently and now also get the one stderr warning naming the file. Conditions: the PBI close-out needs the suites green on a head commit and a code-reviewer GO, and neither is this agent's to give. Nothing staged, committed, pushed or deployed.

changes.why: New tab_bytes(doc) returns json.dumps(doc, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1).encode('utf-8'), the single tab format. main()'s write loop now writes tab_bytes(body) in binary mode, which gives the same bytes as the old text-mode json.dump with newline='\n'. carried(raw, since, path) now does json.loads, the dict check, the marker and tab_bytes inside one try, catching (ValueError, RecursionError). A file that is not a readable JSON object is returned as its raw bytes, with one warning: 'kept file <path> is not a readable JSON object (<reason>); it is kept without carriedSince'. A file already marked is still returned byte for byte, with no warning. The 'same serialisation' comment is removed.

Added test_a_kept_file_json_cannot_round_trip_is_kept_as_it_was_while_others_export (CR-01), test_carried_since_is_the_run_time_converted_to_utc and test_a_source_lost_again_after_recovery_starts_a_new_carry (CR-02). test_kept_tabs_are_byte_identical now asserts the first carry byte for byte against the original file (CR-03), in place of the parsed-equality check. Its later-run byte-stability check is unchanged.

One clause added at the end of the projectTabs store-table row. A kept file that is not a readable JSON object (truncated, not UTF-8, nested too deeply to parse, or holding a lone surrogate escape such as \ud800) is kept unmarked, exactly as it was, with a warning on stderr naming the file, so the page shows no carried warning for it.

tests.covers: CR-PBI024-01. Two projects: app's repo is gone and other is healthy. app.spec holds {"deep": followed by 200000 nested arrays}, and app.decisions holds {"note": "\ud800"}. The test asserts exit 0, both files byte-identical, exactly one stderr mention of each file name, the readable app.assumptions still marked CARRIED_Z, and other.spec rebuilt (generatedAt = the run time) without carriedSince. It failed red with RecursionError before the fix.
CR-PBI024-02. A keep-last run at now 2026-09-11T09:30:00+01:00 marks every kept tab with carriedSince 2026-09-11T08:30:00Z. Dropping .astimezone(timezone.utc) fails it (mutation check).

CR-PBI024-02. The sequence is carry at CARRIED, recover at LATEST (unmarked), then lose the source again at 2026-09-13T07:15:00+00:00. The test asserts every tab equals its recovered export plus carriedSince 2026-09-13T07:15:00Z, not the first carry's time. An exporter that keeps each file's first carriedSince fails it (mutation check).
Truncated JSON, a JSON array and non-UTF-8 bytes are still kept byte for byte with exit 0 under the widened guard.
The rest of the exporter and config suite, including every rebuilt tab now written through tab_bytes(). Ran 274, OK.
The page is unaffected: all 68 page checks passed, exit 0.
Record shapes and conformance, including test_alpha_tabs_are_the_ones_export_board_kept (the round-2 FR-190 version) and validation of every exported document. Ran 90, OK, the count unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: CR-PBI024-01 (MEDIUM, the condition): carried() guards json.loads, json.dumps and the encode as one step against (ValueError, RecursionError), returns raw bytes on failure and prints one stderr warning naming the file. A 200000-deep nested kept file and a U+D800-escape kept file each give exit 0 with bytes unchanged, and the healthy project still exports.
acceptance.evidence: test_a_kept_file_json_cannot_round_trip_is_kept_as_it_was_while_others_export failed red with 'RecursionError: Stack overflow ... while decoding a JSON array' raised out of carried(). After the fix the test passes: exit 0, both files byte-identical, each file named exactly once on stderr, and other.spec rebuilt unmarked. The except clause matches the (ValueError, RecursionError) convention at export_sessions.py:194 and export_catalogue.py:95,110.
